The generated page uses a full-width split-pane coding interface with documentation on the left and editor/test results on the right. The reference focuses on community discussions, contests, interviews, and promotional content; the generated page focuses on a Two Sum solution, explanations, C++ code, and test results. There is very little matching text beyond general LeetCode context.
- **Style (5/15):** Both use a clean white LeetCode-like visual style, light gray borders, blue link accents, and restrained typography. Nevertheless, the generated page has a denser developer-tool appearance, with code formatting, editor panels, and result cards that are absent from the reference.
- **Overall (2/20):** The pages share only broad branding and platform context. Their purpose, layout, content, component hierarchy, and visual composition are fundamentally different.
